name: inspira-aurora-background
blurb: Animated aurora (northern lights) effect with flowing coloured gradients.
description: Full-screen gradient-based background with animated repeating linear gradients creating an aurora effect. Supports dark mode and optional radial gradient mask for vignetting.
use_when: A dramatic full-page background for hero sections or landing pages with a magical, atmospheric feel.
avoid_when: Limited viewport — component uses h-screen and is designed for full-screen contexts.
a11y: Wrapper component; focus and keyboard behaviour come from children. Animation has no prefers-reduced-motion guard.
